name: Distribution Shift Lane Perception
description: A PyTorch-based framework and evaluation pipeline for detecting and quantifying distribution shift in visual lane perception datasets using autoencoder feature extraction and statistical two-sample hypothesis testing.
highlights: Statistical two-sample shift detection (MMD, Energy, BKS) via percentile-calibrated thresholds
Flexible ResNet-18 autoencoder feature extraction with custom, pre-trained, or random weight support
Interactive web GUI command generator and built-in synthetic domain shift perturbation tools
